query:
WITH ranked AS (
                    SELECT id,
                           created_at,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
                    FROM chat_messages
            ),
            candidates AS (
                SELECT id, created_at
                FROM ranked
                WHERE rn > $1
            )
            DELETE FROM chat_messages m
            USING candidates c
            WHERE m.id = c.id AND m.created_at = c.created_at
